criticism: The 'mint' function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to arbitrary value, leading to unexpected token distribution.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in these two lines: 'require(_value <= balances[msg.sender] ); balances[_to] += _value;', leading to unexpected token distribution.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow in these two lines: 'require(_value <= balances[from] ); allowed[from][msg.sender] -= _value; balances[to] += _value;', leading to unexpected token distribution.
